title: Outpaint: extend a picture
description: Add room on the left and right of a picture and fill it in: the model draws the new border to match the picture, which is put back unchanged over the result. 4 steps. Runs on FLUX.2 Klein 4B (Apache-2.0, about 8.9 GB of models); the original picture is also given to the model as a reference.

app.title: Expand
app.summary: Grow a picture on any side and fill in the new area.
